how: Read three HUD regions (fractions of the 1920x1080 frame) every 1 s from 0:00 to 8:19, then at 0.25 s around each new kill-feed line and at 0.1 s around the death. (1) Kill feed, top right under the enemy portraits, x 0.72-1.0, y 0.20-0.38: one line per event, killer on the left and victim on the right, ally names blue, enemy names orange. New lines go in at the top, fade in over about 0.25 s and stay about 4.5 s. A teammate's line that ends on an ally with a round beacon icon is a Rocket revive, not a kill (for example MR.ELK -> VEN, or Alejos2001 -> PunK10). (2) Her KO / DOUBLE / TRIPLE / QUAD / PENTA banner at right middle, x 0.78-1.0, y 0.40-0.57. (3) Her HP readout at bottom center, x 0.43-0.57, y 0.89-0.94. All 14 kill-feed lines with PunK10 as killer line up one-for-one with 14 banners, and no banner appears without a line. Kill times are the first frame where the line shows (the kill happened 0-0.25 s earlier). For deaths: in the 1 s HP scan the only 0/250 readings are 4:28-4:30. The only kill-feed line with PunK10 as victim is VEN -> PunK10 at 4:27.4. Every other 1 s sample shows a live HP number, and the 2 s overview shows Magik on screen in every frame up to the round-end splash at 8:11.

deaths.how: HP 32/250 at 4:27.2, then 0/250 at 4:27.3 and she drops to the floor. Kill-feed line 'VEN -> PunK10' from 4:27.4. Her portrait's health bar is empty. There was no respawn timer or killcam: the camera cut to teammate Alejos2001's (Rocket) beacon, with a 'Reviving' banner from about 4:29.0 to 4:30.7. HP stayed 0/250 until 4:30.7, the kill feed showed 'Alejos2001 -> PunK10' (a revive) at 4:30.8, and she was 'Revived' at 250/250 at 4:30.8-4:31.0, standing at the beacon. She was down 3.5 s, which is why 5 s sampling missed it.
